Iron Tide — CrossFit Gym

The original prompt, shown as plain text. Select the text to copy it.

Prompt

Create a bold, high-energy landing page for a CrossFit affiliate gym called "Iron Tide CrossFit" located in San Diego, CA. The page should convey intensity, community, and results — attracting both seasoned athletes and intimidated newcomers. The design should feel raw and powerful but still clean and modern, not cluttered or aggressive.

1. NAVIGATION BAR
- Logo: "Iron Tide" with a stylized wave-and-barbell icon, white on dark
- Background: #0F172A (slate-900), fully dark navbar
- Links: Programs, Schedule, Coaches, Pricing, Blog
- Right side: "Free Intro Class" CTA button (solid #EF4444 red-500, bold white text)
- Mobile: hamburger menu, "Free Class" mini button visible

2. HERO SECTION (full-bleed video/image background)
- Full-viewport height background: slow-motion video of athletes doing synchronized barbell cleans (fallback: high-contrast photo of gym mid-WOD)
- Dark overlay (rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7)) for text contrast
- Content centered:
  - Eyebrow: "San Diego's #1 Rated CrossFit Box" in uppercase, tracked, #EF4444 red
  - Headline: "Stronger Starts Here." in bold condensed font, white, large (64px desktop)
  - Subheadline: "Coached classes. Proven programming. A community that shows up for each other — every single day."
  - Two CTAs: "Start Your Free Week" (solid red, large) + "View Today's WOD" (outline white, arrow down icon)
- Below hero: scrolling ticker strip — "5:30 AM ✦ 6:30 AM ✦ 9:00 AM ✦ 12:00 PM ✦ 4:30 PM ✦ 5:30 PM ✦ 6:30 PM" showing daily class times on #EF4444 red background, white text, infinite scroll animation

  - Scaling options toggle: "Scale" button reveals beginner modifications (power cleans → 95/65, box jumps → step-ups, muscle-ups → pull-ups)
- Right side: leaderboard preview showing top 3 times from morning classes

  - 2nd: "Sarah L. — 17:15 Rx" (silver)

Design: Bold, high-energy, community-driven. Primary: #EF4444 (red-500 for CTAs, accents, highlights), secondary: #0F172A (slate-900 for dark sections), tertiary: #1E293B (slate-800 for cards on dark backgrounds). White for clean content sections, #F8FAFC for alternating light sections. Typography: Barlow Condensed for headlines (bold, athletic, compressed), Inter for body text. Dark photography with high contrast. Cards with 12px border-radius. Numbers and stats in bold condensed red. Raw, powerful energy balanced with clean modern layout. Think Nike meets community bulletin board.

Responsive: Mobile-first. Hero video may fall back to static image on slower connections. WOD section stacks vertically. Program cards stack. Schedule becomes scrollable day-cards. Coach cards horizontal scroll. Transformation stories stack. Pricing cards stack (Unlimited first). Photo collage becomes 2-column. Map goes full-width above contact info. Sticky bottom CTA bar on mobile: "Free Intro Class" in red. All touch targets minimum 48px for athletic-context tapping.
